name: Battleboar Snout
summary: Near Red Cloud Mesa, young tauren hunters gather Battleboar Snouts as the Bristleback press into their hunting grounds. The snouts also go into stews for the young in Camp Narache.

sections.title: Trophies and Provisions
sections.body: Bristleback quilboar train battleboars in Brambleblade Ravine, beneath Red Cloud Mesa. They send the beasts into tauren hunting grounds. Grull Hawkwind sends young braves to drive them back. A snout proves a battleboar has been brought down, and the tauren cook snouts with flank into rich stews for their young.

faq.q: What are Battleboar Snouts used for?
aliases: what does grull do with snouts
faq.answer: In Camp Narache, Grull Hawkwind asks young hunters to gather Battleboar Snouts and meat flanks. The snouts prove threatening boars have been slain, and the tauren cook them into stew for the tribe's youth.

faq.q: Where do these snouts come from?
faq.answer: Battleboar Snouts come from Battleboars and Bristleback Battleboars near the edges of Red Cloud Mesa and throughout Brambleblade Ravine to the east.

faq.q: Why are the battleboars encroaching on tauren land?
faq.answer: Hostile Bristleback quilboar have trained the battleboars to be exceptionally vicious. The boars push from Brambleblade Ravine into traditional tauren hunting grounds.

angles.text: As a tauren, gathering the snout with the meat honors the Earthmother's balance. It curbs an encroaching predator and provides food for the young in Camp Narache.
As a cook, you can slowly boil tough cuts like snouts over a fire for tribal campfire stews.
